rawInput.answer: Application-level route wiring lives in lib/application.js: app.init() lazily creates `this.router` via `new Router(...)` (line ~64-75), and app.use/app.route/app.handle (defined later in the same file) delegate registration and dispatch to that router instance. The router itself is NOT implemented in this repo — it's the external npm package `router` (imported via `var Router = require('router');` at lib/application.js:26, and listed as a dependency `"router": "^2.2.0"` in package.json), a separate expressjs org repo.
